data.name: Invoke Decay
data.description: A rot warden can channel stored spell energy into specific spells he hasn't prepared ahead of time. He can "lose" a prepared spell in order to cast the following spells at the indicated levels: 1st-decompose corpse UM , 2nd-warp wood, 3rd-fungal infestation (UM), 4th-explosion of rot, 5th-insect plague, 6th-swarm skin (APG), 7th-creeping doom, 8th-horrid wilting, 9th-massacre (HA). This alters spontaneous casting.
